item.title: v0.4
item.description:
Changes

  • Added Petrapixel button for having a nice page with useful tutorials.
  • New todos.
  • Made He/They look “more clickable”.

  • Migrated the whole website to Gohugo

    Changes caused by migration:
    • Added cache-busting.
    • Removed lies.
    • Uploaded the website to Github for version control & to opensource.
    • Standardized styles across all website.
    • All of website’s images not can be accessed with ‘assets’ and ’e’

Fixes:

  • Fixed #gaypng on lies page being too big when viewed on mobile.
  • Fixed text-woke having the wrong interpolation.
  • Fixed Virkroz button having Blin’s alt and title.
  • Fixed one of the homepage’s elements being defined in base.css
